name: Raene's Cleansing
summary: A Glowing Gem brings Raene's Cleansing to a turning point in Ashenvale. Raene Wolfrunner sends you east of Iris Lake to ask the dryad Shael'dryn how Dartol's ancient rod can be restored.

sections.title: A Clue in Teronis's Notes
sections.body: Raene Wolfrunner studies the field notes left by the sentinel Teronis, who died while investigating Ashenvale's troubled furbolgs. His research points to an ancient rod crafted by a night elf named Dartol. Raene has recovered a Glowing Gem, but her skill as a huntress cannot unravel the arcane and natural mysteries surrounding the relic.

sections.title: Seeking the Daughters of Cenarius
sections.body: Raene sends you northeast toward Iris Lake to seek Shael'dryn, a dryad who dwells beside a moonwell. As one of the Daughters of Cenarius, Shael'dryn understands the forest and ancient relics. Bring her the Glowing Gem, and she may reveal what else is needed to restore Dartol's Rod.

faq.answer: Teronis was a night elf scout sent by Astranaar to investigate the corruption spreading through Ashenvale. He died on that mission, but his recovered journal offered a clue: restoring Dartol's Rod might help the land.
Dartol's Rod is an ancient magical artifact that Raene Wolfrunner hopes will aid her investigation of Ashenvale's furbolgs. The recovered Glowing Gem is one piece needed to restore it.
Shael'dryn lives beside a secluded moonwell northeast of Astranaar, in the hills just east of Iris Lake. Follow the road east, then turn north before the dangerous lands near Raynewood Retreat.
The Glowing Gem is one piece of Dartol's Rod, recovered from the ruins of Teronis's investigation. Shael'dryn needs it to discover the rod's other pieces.

faq.q: Why does Raene Wolfrunner send you to a dryad?
faq.answer: Raene Wolfrunner is a huntress and leader of Astranaar's sentinels, focused on defending the town. Dryads, the Daughters of Cenarius, understand ancient relics and the restoration of nature.

faq.q: Why is the forest around Iris Lake in danger?
faq.answer: Corruption and unrest are spreading among Ashenvale's wildlife and furbolg tribes. Raene hopes restoring the rod will help her understand the furbolgs' plight.

angles.text: Restoring the rod carries on Teronis's unfinished investigation into the troubles of Ashenvale's furbolgs.
As a druid, helping Shael'dryn serves your Cenarion duty to mend the broken bonds between nature and Kaldorei magic.
As an Alliance member, helping secure ancient artifacts and strengthen Astranaar's northern perimeter supports the war effort against growing threats in the region.
